assessment.body:
## Verdict

agent_supports: yes
daemon_capability: incapable
driver_capability: n/a

## Reasoning

OpenCode 2.1.4 has a structured, blocking question: its `question` tool (`opencode.tool.question`, strings scan) raises a session **form** the user answers, and the service API exposes it (`GET/POST /api/session/{id}/form`, `…/form/{formID}/reply`; the bus carries `form.created` / `form.replied` / `form.cancelled`). So `agent_supports: yes` — a change from the V1 column, whose 1.x agent had no such primitive.

## Why the daemon cannot observe it

The 2.x plugin forwards exactly five bus events to the daemon — `permission.asked`, `permission.replied` and the three `session.execution.*` turn ends (`plugin_v2.js` lines 48-64, `IRRLICHT_EVENTS`). No `form.*` event is among them: #2108 excluded forms, and the maintainer's Q4 decision on #2109 keeps that exclusion out of P5 and freezes this cell as daemon-incapable.

The store gives no fallback. The 2.1.4 openapi lists no form message type among `Session.Message.*` (agent-selected, assistant, compaction, idle, location-switched, model-selected, shell, skill, synthetic, system, user), so a form leaves no row of its own. A `question` tool call that raised it would show only as a running tool item, which the 2.x reader reads as working. And the 2.x reader has no waiting rule at all: `grep -i waiting` over watcher_v2.go, parser_v2.go and metrics_v2.go finds only a comment; waiting comes only from the plugin's `permission.asked`.

## What would flip this

Forwarding `form.created` / `form.replied` / `form.cancelled` from the 2.x plugin and mapping them in the receiver — out of P5 by the maintainer's decision; nothing is filed.
caveats: Frozen by the maintainer's Q4 decision (#2109, issuecomment-6455742776), not by a recording; the code citation is the evidence.

sources.note: IRRLICHT_EVENTS (lines 48-64) forwards permission.asked, permission.replied and session.execution.{succeeded,failed,interrupted} — nothing else, so no form.* event reaches the daemon (#2108, merged as #2115)
the 2.1.4 service's openapi: GET/POST /api/session/{sessionID}/form, GET/DELETE /api/session/{sessionID}/form/{formID}, POST …/form/{formID}/reply — sessions have forms
strings scan of the OpenCode 2.1.4 binary (not run): the counts and lines this cell cites
2.x hook receiver: permission.asked holds waiting, session.execution.{succeeded,failed,interrupted} end the turn through HandleStopHook (#2108)
Q4: freeze 2-17 and 2-27 as daemon-incapable; forwarding form.* stays out of P5
